➤ 7. Key Coin Highlights

↳ XRP hit a new all-time high above $3.60.

↳ Dogecoin rallied ~11% amid 66% surge in volume.

↳ Ethereum Classic (ETC) jumped ~20%, rebounding strongly. https://t.co/df9c42buIa

➤ 5. Institutions Keep Buying 

↳ Michael Saylor’s firm added 4,225 BTC (~$472M)
• Now holds over $71B in Bitcoin

↳ Bit Origin plans to buy $500M worth of Dogecoin
• Possibly linked to Elon Musk’s payments integration https://t.co/T99SvHA5QN

➤ 3. Top Gainers & Movers 

↳ 1. Gainer:
• Conflux (CFX): +97% 

↳ Other strong performers:
• Tezos (XTZ): +42%
• Dymension (DYM): +17%
• Dogecoin (DOGE): +11%
